learningObjective: Compute the per-rank bandwidth term of a ring-AllReduce for a tensor of S bytes across N ranks.

hardwareContext.architecture: Ring topology (e.g. NVLink ring, InfiniBand ring)
requiredFeatures: symmetric point-to-point bandwidth BW between neighbors

stem: A tensor of S bytes is AllReduce-summed over N ranks via the ring algorithm (ReduceScatter + AllGather), on a ring where each neighbor link has effective bandwidth BW. Ignoring the fixed latency term, which expression best approximates the per-rank bandwidth-limited time?

options.text: S / BW, because the tensor is only transmitted once around the ring.
N · S / BW, because each rank has to forward the full tensor to every other rank.
2·(N-1)/N · S / BW, from ReduceScatter (N-1)/N · S and AllGather (N-1)/N · S.
log₂(N) · S / BW, because the ring implements a recursive halving reduction internally.

explanation: The ring algorithm splits the payload into N chunks. During ReduceScatter, each chunk travels through N-1 hops but each rank only sends/receives (N-1)/N · S bytes total. AllGather then propagates the reduced chunks through another (N-1)/N · S bytes. Total bandwidth cost per rank ≈ 2·(N-1)/N · S, approaching 2S for large N; not S, not N·S, and not log₂(N)·S.

optionExplanations.A: Wrong: the tensor is transmitted twice (once during reduce-scatter and once during all-gather).
optionExplanations.B: Wrong: describes a naive scheme where each rank sends the whole tensor to each of N-1 peers.
optionExplanations.C: Correct: the classical ring-AllReduce bandwidth cost.
optionExplanations.D: Wrong: log₂(N) scaling belongs to recursive halving / doubling on a hypercube-like topology, not to a ring.

assumptions: Fixed latency term α per phase is negligible relative to the bandwidth term.
Even chunking by N; edge effects of remainder chunks are ignored.
nonImplications: Does not imply the wall-clock time is independent of N (the latency term α·2(N-1) still scales with N).
Does not imply that ring is optimal for all N and S; for very small S the latency-dominated regime favors trees.

distractorRationales.B: Confuses ring with an all-to-all broadcast.

performanceClaim.scope: Ring-AllReduce bandwidth term for a payload of S bytes on N ranks
